attempts.text:
**The window starts on the anchor `cobO`.** Column 0 is the only spine here: all 534 chromosomes carry it, it is persistent, and 0% of calls there are in a region of plasticity. The model names it in 99.6% of calls, with 0.17 bits.

**Then 79 fork and variable columns open up**, columns 1 to 79, where 0 to 33% of calls are in a region of plasticity. The model names 67 to 99% of genes, fewest at column 24, 67%, and hesitates most at column 29, 1.10 bits. Inside a region of plasticity it names 64% of genes against 96% outside, and hesitates 1.80 bits against 0.21.

**The first branch runs through columns 1 to 24**, 24 families carried by 10 to 12% of chromosomes, from `yciK` to `fabI`, including `topA`, `acnA`, `ribA` and `rnb`. A second branch, `sapF` to `puuB`, spans columns 26 to 38, [[peptide transport and putrescine export]]. The `psp` branch, columns 40 to 45, [[phage shock stress response]], is persistent throughout.

**The `trp` operon sits at columns 5 to 10**, [[tryptophan biosynthesis]], persistent at 88%. The `opp` operon, columns 24 to 28, [[murein tripeptide transport]], is persistent, and the `nar` genes, columns 40 to 46, [[nitrate reduction]], follow. The window ends at column 79, `cvrA`, carried by 34% of chromosomes.

label: cobO
facts:
WINDOW: the cobO window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor cobO, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,417 to 2,496 from dnaA. Read in 534 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying cobO once); 42,720 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.53 bits on average (perplexity 1.7 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 31,424 calls, named 97%, 0.16 bits; shell 9,747 calls, named 76%, 1.20 bits; cloud 1,549 calls, named 14%, 3.88 bits. Outside an RGP 33,993 calls, named 96%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 8,727 calls, named 64%, 1.80 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 68 fork, 11 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.80 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (64% against 96%); 8,727 of the 42,720 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 29 ("hypothetical protein") 1.10 bits, RGP 26%; column 21 (yciY) 1.05 bits, RGP 25%; column 14 (ompW) 1.03 bits, RGP 14%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-33%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: cobO. named 99.6%; 0.17 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-33%. named 67-99% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 24, named 67%; most hesitant at column 29, 1.10 bits.
   a second branch of 24 families through columns 1-24, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-12%, 23 P, 1 S; the branch's families: yciK, sohB, yciN, topA, cysB, ymiA, yciX, ymiC, acnA, ribA, pgpB, lapA, lapB, pyrF, yciH, osmB, yciT, yciZ, ymiD, pdeR, "hypothetical protein", rnb, yciW, fabI
